rationale: S-0065-01 proposes applying the EPSP_PASSIVE / IPSP_PASSIVE / FULL trial-mode protocol to the from-scratch DSGC family substrate (t0052-t0059). The more recent S-0066-02 (raised after t0066 confirmed cross-bed convergence on the e_GABA = v_rest = -60 mV shunting design) articulates the same experiment more clearly and motivates it more sharply (it explicitly contrasts a from-scratch e_GABA != v_rest binary-trap hypothesis against a from-scratch e_GABA = v_rest shunting hypothesis). Keeping S-0066-02 and rejecting S-0065-01 as a duplicate so the high-priority shelf does not contain both.
